name: 陈旧菌洞短廊
architecture: Full earth roof and parallel closed side walls
Five weathered stone arches; center arch has a chipped crown
Four giant red mushrooms, mycelium shelves, hanging roots and off-path cobwebs
Cyan glass/sea-lantern recesses and upright white end-rod strips
reference_adaptations: The distant closed-looking panel is replaced with an open south arch to preserve a true through corridor
Cyan-white lighting uses vanilla sea lanterns, cyan glass and end rods; no custom glowing mushroom or shader
placement_policy: Independent authoring asset only. Explicit air is present; integrator must reject occupied/fluid/entity volume before placement. Never blindly clear a world.
